title: Chale Ayiye Moula
body:
Aye yusuf e zahra..(2)
Aye yusuf e zahra zara jalwa to dikha de
aye muntaqim e karbobala parda utha de
ye khwahish e zahra hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula
Zahra ne bulaya hai chale aaiye maula
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aap aaenge to adl se duniya ko bharenge
mazloom se ye zalimo jabir bhi darenge
har dil ki tamanna hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ghurbat ko meri dekh ke kuch laaye hai maula
mai ghar mein hu aur ghar mein mere aaye hai maula
kal khwaab ye dekha hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hum hurr ki tarha aaj ki karbal mein ladenge
hum kufiyo jaisi koi harkat na karenge
kya aapko dhadka hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Purse ke liye baithe hai payghambar o haider
shehzadiye kaunain bhi hai farsh e azaa par
majlis yaha barpa hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mayoos zamana hai dua koi nahi hai
ab qabr pe zahra ke diya koi nahi hai
veeraan madina hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Faryad kuna bint e shehenshah e madina
paani ke liye deti hai aawaaz sakina
jalta hua kurta hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Roti hai bohot khoo bhare kurte ko utha kar
kehti hai rabab aaj bhi jhule ko jhula kar
asghar mera pyaasa hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bikhre hue tukde hai qamar waqt kada hai
be goro kafan laasha e shabbir pada hai
maula ka janaza hai, chale aaiye maula
<<MINI>>
taraaj baqaiyya hai chale aaiye maula..(2)
